_comment: Known-broken (version, loader, side, scenario) combinations, used by the functional test harness
to mark expected failures without turning CI red. See harness/src/main/java/.../KnownIssues.java.
Every entry MUST have: branch, reason, issue. Any of mc/loader/side/scenario may be omitted, which
means '*' (the whole row of the matrix). A marked combination that FAILS is recorded as a known
failure and the build stays green; a marked combination that PASSES fails the build with a 'stale
marking, please remove' message, so a marking can never outlive the bug it describes.
Keep this array empty until a real, tracked incompatibility is found: an empty file means 'nothing
is known to be broken', which is the correct starting state for branch 26.1.
